title: Tester uses only allowed predicates
statement: Let $T$ be a tester with a finite seed space and a probability law on its seeds, and let $\Psi$ be a set of sign predicates. The tester uses only predicates in $\Psi$ if, for every seed, the predicate in the check selected by that seed belongs to $\Psi$.
hypotheses_covered: A tester with a finite seed space
A probability law on the seed space
